value.title: Battle of Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier (1488)
value.snippet: The Battle of Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier took place on 28 July 1488, between the forces of King Charles VIII of France, and those of Francis II, Duke of Brittany

value.title: Château de Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier
value.snippet: Château de Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier is a medieval castle, built in the 13th century in the commune of Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier in the département d'Ille-et-Vilaine

value.title: Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier
value.snippet: Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier (French pronunciation: [sɛ̃.t‿obɛ̃ dy kɔʁmje]; Gallo: Grand'Saent Aubin, Breton: Sant-Albin-an-Hiliber) is a commune in the Ille-et-Vilaine

value.title: Battle of Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier (1796)
value.snippet: The second Battle of Saint-Aubin du Cormier was a conflict between the anti-revolutionary Chouans and the French Republican forces during the Chouannerie

value.title: Canton of Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier
value.snippet: The canton of Saint-Aubin-du-Cormier is a former canton of France, located in the arrondissement of Fougères-Vitré, in the Ille-et-Vilaine département
